text:
Analysts See $1.07 EPS for Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE) Posted by Pete Kolinski 9:58 pm
Analysts expect Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) to report $1.07 EPS on February, 5.They anticipate $0.37 EPS change or 25.69 % from last quarter’s $1.44 EPS. LITE’s profit would be $79.51M giving it 10.68 P/E if the $1.07 EPS is correct. After having $1.14 EPS previously, Lumentum Holdings Inc.’s analysts see -6.14 % EPS growth. The stock increased 1.42% or $0.64 during the last trading session, reaching $45.73. About 884,528 shares traded. Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) has declined 10.61% since January 11, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 10.61% the S&P500.
Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company has market cap of $3.40 billion. It operates through two divisions, Optical Communications and Commercial Lasers. It has a 10.2 P/E ratio. The Optical Communications segment offers components, modules, and subsystems that enable the transmission and transport of video, audio, and text data over high-capacity fiber optic cables.
